entities.summary: Ty Dellandrea is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a centre and right wing for the San Jose Sharks of the National Hockey League (NHL). Dellandrea was selected in the first round, 13th overall, by the Dallas Stars in the 2018 NHL entry draft.
